translations.title: Translations
translations.lede: The interface is written in English and then translated. Every language says how far people have checked it; no language is hidden because it is a draft.
translations.scope: These labels describe the interface. Articles and news carry their own language and translation notes.
translations.help: If you know one of these languages well, tell us what sounds wrong. A status rises only when a named reviewer has actually checked the text and agrees to be listed.

reference.label: Reference
reference.description: The original text of the interface; every other language is translated from it.

machine_draft.label: Machine draft
machine_draft.description: Drafted with the help of a machine. No review by a person is recorded, so it may contain mistakes.

community_reviewed.label: Community reviewed
community_reviewed.description: Checked by members of the community who use this language.

native_reviewed.label: Native reviewed
native_reviewed.description: Checked by a native speaker of this language.
